verdict: Site traffic growing, but paid ads are dark and key milestones are overdue.
narrative: Your website held steady this period — GA4 sessions are up 5.47% week over week, reaching an average of 377 daily sessions in the last three days, entirely without paid media support. No Meta or Google ads ran at any point in the last 28 days, which means all of that momentum is organic. Google Business Profile actions dipped 29.29% week over week, though the last three days show a likely reporting lag rather than a true drop. Five planned milestones — including the Live-Cooking Shoot, Pre-Launch Gate, and SEO Phase 1 — are overdue, and closing those is the immediate focus heading into September.

highlights.phrase: website sessions in the last 28 days, with no paid ads running
Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and site clicks
planned milestones now overdue, being resolved this week

watch_item.issue: Five SOW milestones are overdue, stalling the launch of paid media and core funnel infrastructure.
watch_item.fix: These are being worked through this week in priority order — Pre-Launch Gate and Funnel setup first — so ads can go live before the next reporting window.
